iphone_apps.name: Naver Map, Navigation
iphone_apps.why_essential: Google Maps walking and driving directions do not work in South Korea due to national security and mapping laws. Naver Map is the #1 gold standard for precise subway platforms, bus arrival countdowns, and walking paths.
iphone_apps.sf_japan_comparison: Your replacement for Google Maps and Apple Maps in Korea.
iphone_apps.beginner_tip: In App Settings -> Language, switch to English. You can save favorite places (like your hotel) in custom lists. It shows exact exit numbers for subway stations!

iphone_apps.name: KakaoMap - Korea No.1 Map
iphone_apps.why_essential: Great backup/alternative to Naver Map. Many locals prefer KakaoMap for bus arrival accuracy and street-view ('Road View') quality.
iphone_apps.sf_japan_comparison: Like Citymapper for Seoul and Busan.
iphone_apps.beginner_tip: Works seamlessly with Kakao T when calling a taxi to a specific pin on the map.

iphone_apps.name: Kakao T (Taxi, Bike, Driver)
iphone_apps.why_essential: The undisputed king of taxi dispatching in South Korea. Never worry about language barriers with taxi drivers—your destination is sent automatically to the driver's GPS.
iphone_apps.sf_japan_comparison: Direct equivalent to Uber or Lyft in San Francisco, or JapanTaxi/GO app in Tokyo.
iphone_apps.beginner_tip: You can use Kakao T without a Korean credit card! Select 'General Taxi' and choose 'Pay to Driver' (Cash/Card to driver) as your payment method. Pay the driver with your WOWPASS, T-money, or foreign Visa/Mastercard at the end of the ride.

iphone_apps.name: Uber / UT
iphone_apps.why_essential: In South Korea, the global Uber app operates as a joint venture called UT, dispatching official licensed taxis. If you already have Uber installed on your iPhone from SF, it works right away!
iphone_apps.sf_japan_comparison: The exact same Uber app you use in San Francisco—your saved credit card in Uber will be charged automatically in KRW.
iphone_apps.beginner_tip: Compare prices between Kakao T and Uber during rush hours. Uber often has promos for first-time rides in Korea.

iphone_apps.name: KorailTalk
iphone_apps.why_essential: The official KORAIL app for booking KTX high-speed trains between Seoul, Busan, Gyeongju, and Jeonju.
iphone_apps.sf_japan_comparison: Like the SmartEX app for Japan Shinkansen or Amtrak app.
iphone_apps.beginner_tip: Set language to English in the top-right menu. Book KTX tickets 2-4 weeks in advance for weekend travel (tickets open 1 month in advance at 07:00 KST).

iphone_apps.name: Subway Korea (Malang Studio)
iphone_apps.why_essential: The fastest, most reliable English subway map and timetable app for Seoul, Busan, Daegu, Gwangju, and Daejeon. Works offline!
iphone_apps.sf_japan_comparison: Like Japan Travel by NAVITIME subway view or BART official app.
iphone_apps.beginner_tip: Shows which subway car door (e.g. Car 4, Door 2) to board for the fastest transfer or exit!

iphone_apps.name: Naver Papago - AI Translator
iphone_apps.why_essential: Naver's AI translation engine is vastly superior to Google Translate for Korean honorifics, idioms, and natural grammar. Essential for dining, taxis, and shopping.
iphone_apps.sf_japan_comparison: Far more accurate for Korean than Google Translate.
iphone_apps.beginner_tip: Use 'Image Translation' mode to snap photos of Korean restaurant menus or bus terminal signs for instant English overlays!

iphone_apps.name: T-money GO (Integrated Transit & Express Bus)
iphone_apps.why_essential: Book highway express buses and intercity buses nationwide. Also integrates city bike rentals (Ttareungyi in Seoul).
iphone_apps.sf_japan_comparison: Like a Greyhound/Flixbus app combined with city bikeshare.
iphone_apps.beginner_tip: If you have trouble with international credit cards on the app, you can check bus schedules here and buy tickets at the terminal ticket machines or windows.

iphone_apps.name: BUSTAGO (Intercity Bus Reservation)
iphone_apps.why_essential: Official nationwide intercity bus booking platform. Essential for routes to smaller towns or direct airport bus connections.
iphone_apps.beginner_tip: Supports English interface and ticket QR codes.
